title: plugin-descriptor

version.description: identity/version pin; a registration binds it together with the descriptor bytes and the implementation the OS derives from the command

implementation.description: additional files or directories (project-relative or absolute; {project_root}/{plugin_dir} substituted) that the entry point loads and that the command vector does not name; bound with the program, the named scripts and module-form packages the OS derives itself (BC-P2-40). Every listed path must exist.

artefacts.description: files or directories the plugin loads as its model (weights, tokenizer, configuration), project-relative or absolute ({project_root}/{plugin_dir} substituted); typically outside the plugin's own directory, e.g. a model cache

model.description: IP-R2-13 (BC-P2-30): the model artefacts an embed/rerank plugin loads. Every listed path must exist; for an executable plugin their bytes are bound by the registration (role `model`; a changed byte fails closed, PLUGIN_PIN_MISMATCH) and the retrieval profile identifies the model from them (repository paths in the index manifest's hashed core, machine-local paths in runtime meta).

artefacts.description: files or directories of the inference runtime the plugin loads (libraries, a model server, an environment's packages), project-relative or absolute ({project_root}/{plugin_dir} substituted)

runtime.description: IP-R2-13 (BC-P2-30): the inference runtime an embed/rerank plugin loads beyond its program. Every listed path must exist; for an executable plugin their bytes are bound by the registration (role `runtime`) and the retrieval profile identifies the runtime from them.

approved_roles.description: roles the descriptor asks to be limited to; it may only NARROW the authority floor, never widen it. The authoritative list for a registered plugin is the registry's.

required_permission_classes.description: permission classes the acting role must hold (narrowing only); declaring none does not make an executable plugin non-elevated

permissions.description: DECLARED access, shown to the approver of the registration gate; not enforced at run time and never deciding whether approval is needed (BC-P2-39)

pin.description: OS-written copy of the implementation binding (sha256 over every bound file, and the bound paths); a hand-written pin can only add a check

provenance.description: advisory copy of the registration recorded by `gov plugins register`; proves nothing on its own (the registry is authoritative)

registration_gate.description: a request naming a candidate gate; the registry records the gate that approved the registration subject, and a gate raised for anything else never approves it

description: A capability plugin descriptor. Discovery only: approved_roles, provenance, status and registration_gate describe REQUESTED properties and never grant authority. Authorisation derives from verified kernel policy (TOOL_POLICY.plugins.min_authority, TOOL_PERMISSIONS) and from the OS-written, T2-sealed plugin registry (TOOL_POLICY.plugins.registry_path); every executable plugin (anything but this gov binary's own capability server) runs only with a registration approved by a Human Decision Gate raised for its identity, version, implementation and permission set (BC-P2-39).
